title: Normalize DiagGUI Spectrum FFT products

characterization.evidence_boundary: These are installed-parser observations on generated source-grounded XML. They do not establish a real export, physical unit, or FFT normalization convention. The committed audit report is docs/plans/2026-09-25-diaggui-xml-product-audit.md#fft-stf-and-other-subtypes.

supported_layouts: Spectrum/0, Array Type floatComplex, one row, linear f0/df axis
Spectrum/4, Array Type floatComplex, one row, embedded complex64 frequency words with exactly zero imaginary components
implementation_scope.key_mode: Spectrum/0 and /4 use channel keys from ChannelA; existing channel/pair layouts are selected explicitly in native subtype metadata.
implementation_scope.return_contract: FrequencySeriesDict readers retain ChannelA keys; direct FrequencySeries reads return a FrequencySeries. Values and phase are copied from the raw stream. No FFT unit or normalization is inferred.
failures: declared row or stream count mismatches
embedded FFT frequency values with nonzero imaginary components
uncharacterized native FFT array precision such as doubleComplex
implementation_scope.unsupported_variants: No evidence was collected for doubleComplex FFT storage or other Spectrum subtypes/layouts beyond 0 and 4; these remain unsupported by this change.

performance.protocol: Same /tmp/issue731_parser_characterization.xml containing one Spectrum/0 and one Spectrum/4 result; load_dttxml_products; five warmups; 50 timed calls; report median wall time. tracemalloc measured peak Python-traced allocation for one call after warmup. No numeric threshold was used.

code_source.before: The clean issue worktree at base SHA aaf91486e4a8cc34eb6a678acccd2ff070d3c157, measured before source edits; no separate temporary checkout or module was used.
code_source.after: The same issue worktree after the #731 implementation.
code_source.route_imports: Each process imported the issue worktree from its working directory or explicit PYTHONPATH. External and native used the gwexpy conda Python; fallback used /tmp/gwexpy-diaggui-a-base/bin/python with dttxml absent.

performance.measurement_limit: tracemalloc does not include all NumPy/native allocations; the values characterize Python-traced peak memory, not process RSS.
performance.interpretation: The additional wall time is associated with decoding and constructing two newly returned FrequencySeries objects where the prior code emitted no FFT product. Traced peak allocation stayed within 0.2 percent across the measured routes; small-fixture timing is descriptive only.

review_correction_probe.protocol: Same characterized /tmp/issue731_parser_characterization.xml. Five warmups and 50 load_dttxml_products calls per route; compare current code with the FFT raw-XML validation helper replaced by a no-op to isolate its incremental cost.
review_correction_probe.interpretation: The added raw XML metadata inspection costs about 22 microseconds on this small fixture. This is a descriptive single-fixture comparison without a fixed threshold; it does not include process RSS.

check_physics: FFT values and axes are copied without a physical-unit or normalization claim

review.reason: No physical unit or FFT normalization is inferred; values and coordinates are preserved from the selected XML stream.
review.independent_sol_review: Preliminary exact-head review identified two Major findings. Both are addressed in this follow-up; a new exact-head review is pending after the parent rebases this branch onto the merged #734 base.

corrections.finding: External FFT conversion replaced a nonzero single-bin frequency with the FrequencySeries default zero origin.
corrections.correction: For FFT-only strict-axis conversion, a one-bin axis is passed explicitly to FrequencySeries(frequencies=...). PSD/CSD/COH/TF construction is unchanged.
corrections.regression: Spectrum/0 f0=17.5 and Spectrum/4 embedded f=31.25 are asserted through installed dttxml, native, and a separate interpreter without dttxml; both direct and dictionary reads are covered.

corrections.finding: The installed dttxml FFT path trusted parsed data without validating the XML Array Type, allowing doubleComplex subtype 0 with N=8 to be reinterpreted as finite but incorrect complex64 samples.
corrections.correction: Before returning external FFT products, inspect raw Spectrum subtype 0/4 XML Array Type and reject anything except characterized floatComplex. Validation is scoped to FFT results.
corrections.regression: An adversarial N=8 doubleComplex subtype 0 fixture must raise ValueError with native and external parsers.
